and removed from the battlefield.

not in enemy Territory within @ of its current
position, starting with the Blue player. Each
Bomb Cart may be placed this way only once

been placed, players score 2 VP for each Bomb

Territory and that is within € of another

are completely within Contested Territory.

Contesting 1 or more Waypoints remove 1 fewer
Suppression token during the Remove Tokens
step.

rules.en:
Setup: Place 4 Flags (POI) as shown on the
Outflank Map Card.

Starting with the Blue player, each player
chooses up to 3 of their non-vAw units that are
not being transported. Each chosen unit gains a
Vanguard token.

Scoring: Starting in the second Round, during
each End Phase, players score 1 VP for each
Flag they Secure. Additionally, if a player
controls 2 or more units with Vanguard tokens
that are Contesting Flags Secured by that player,
that player scores 1 additional VP.

Special Rules: Units with Vanguard tokens
must Deploy into the portion of a player's
Territory that is touching the short battlefield
edges. Unless they are Deployed using the
TRANSPORT keyword, only units with
Vanguard tokens may Deploy in this portion of
a player’ territory.
